# HeDE / GeST Installer - the Harbor GRUB theme, generated by helm-theme.
# Do not edit; regenerated on every theme/world change. Pairs with the

# baked into background.png; this lays the boot menu + countdown over it, the
# letterbox + highlighted entry tinted to the active world's accent. Consumed
# by the live CD (ISO grub.cfg inject) and installed systems (GRUB_THEME).
